# Version 3.0.0
> **Modernized SkiaSharp preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.0.0-preview.5.4)

> **Superseded by [3.116.0](3.116.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.116.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.0.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.0 modernizes the binding and moves to the Skia m116 renderer. This preview adds new APIs and platform support while removing obsolete v2 surface area. Review the breaking changes before migrating.

## Breaking Changes

- **Obsolete v2 APIs were removed** — Deprecated graphics, text, bitmap, codec, and OpenGL APIs are no longer available. Replace each call with the successor named in the API diff before upgrading. ([#2539](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2539))
- **Legacy Index8 bitmap support was removed** — Color-table and Index8 bitmap and codec overloads are gone. Use supported color types and the current pixel installation and decoding overloads.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m116** — Updates the bundled rendering engine and its native dependencies for the 3.0 line. — ❤️ [@Redth](https://github.com/Redth) ([#2829](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2829), [#2885](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2885), [#3026](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3026))

## API Surface

- **New graphics and span APIs** — Adds SKBlender, picture recording options, raw image shaders, pixel spans, and span-based geometry and color-filter overloads. — ❤️ [@Youssef1313](https://github.com/Youssef1313) ([#2830](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2830), [#2883](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2883), [#2889](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2889), [#2748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2748), [#2609](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2609), [#2949](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2949), [#2879](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2879))

## Platform

- **Expanded desktop, Apple, and WinUI support** — Adds accelerated WinUI views and WPF SKGLElement support, aligns Metal targets, and includes ANGLE runtime assets. — ❤️ [@gmurray81](https://github.com/gmurray81), [@maxkatz6](https://github.com/maxkatz6) ([#2733](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2733), [#2317](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2317), [#2788](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2788), [#2747](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2747), [#2970](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2970))

## Bug Fixes

- **View and rendering reliability improvements** — Fixes MAUI and Uno canvas lifetime issues, Apple Metal snapshots, kerning, and cloned paint disposal. — ❤️ [@Youssef1313](https://github.com/Youssef1313), [@jeromelaban](https://github.com/jeromelaban), [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast), [@pdjonov](https://github.com/pdjonov), [@jeremy-visionaid](https://github.com/jeremy-visionaid) ([#2955](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2955), [#2918](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2918), [#2854](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2854), [#2804](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2804), [#2858](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2858), [#2904](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2904))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz binding and modernizes its interop for the 3.0 release line.
